components.heading: No exemptions for prior commencement or expansion.
components.text: No tax exemption shall be granted to any business which commenced operations prior to August 5, 1986, nor for the expansion of a business unless such expansion created new employment after August 5, 1986. (Ord. 17270 § 18, 6-2-98; Ord. 16349 § 18, 7-23-91. Code 1981 § 42-48. Code 1995 § 138-93.)
